`solve_model` converts `n.snapshots`, not the snapshots stored in the model, and `_to_model` only flattens indexes when the model uses flat snapshots. For example, if a model is built with a plain snapshot index and the network is subsequently given investment periods (making `n.snapshots` a MultiIndex), `solve_model` passes that MultiIndex unchanged to `extra_functionality`, although the model was built with a plain index.
